jobs.title: Software Engineer, New Grad
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As a Software Engineer on the Software Engineering team, you will help build and improve the core systems powering our AI products and operations. You’ll contribute to the platforms that shape how users and developers interact with our AI technology at scale. This role is designed for early-career engineers—new graduates or those with up to 1–2 years of experience—who are eager to learn, collaborate, and deliver impactful solutions alongside experienced mentors.

You’ll work on critical components of our technology stack, from backend services to frontend interfaces, and gain exposure to system architecture, infrastructure, and cross-functional collaboration. Your work will directly influence the reliability, scalability, and user experience of our AI platform.

What You Will Do

  • Design, implement, and maintain backend features and APIs using modern frameworks to power authentication, billing, AI tooling, and more.

  • Develop scalable and robust user-facing features with TypeScript, React, and Next.js, ensuring seamless integration with backend systems.

  • Collaborate with infrastructure teams to deploy, monitor, and optimize system performance in a production environment.

  • Write clean, well-tested code and participate in code reviews to uphold team standards and improve internal tools.

  • Work with product managers, designers, and engineers across AI Studio, Le Chat, and Mistral Code to deliver end-to-end features.

  • Solve real-world engineering challenges, from performance bottlenecks to integrating new AI capabilities.

  • Communicate progress, trade-offs, and technical constraints clearly to stakeholders.

  • Take ownership of your learning path, experimenting with new technologies and best practices under mentorship.

What We're Looking For

  • A recent graduate (or soon-to-be) with a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience.

  • Proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, C++, or Golang.

  • Solid understanding of core computer science and system architecture fundamentals.

  • Experience building software projects through internships, personal initiatives, open-source contributions, or academic work.

  • A problem-solver who pays attention to detail and cares about building reliable, user-focused systems.

  • Proactive, curious, and willing to own small features end-to-end with guidance.

  • Clear communicator who enjoys collaborating in a low-ego, team-oriented environment.

  • Interest or exposure to infrastructure (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD), AI/ML engineering, observability tools, or UX/product-centric thinking.

 

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Solution Operations Manager, Revenue Growth
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

 

As a direct business partner to our Solutions team (Deployment Strategists & Applied AI Engineering team), you will work closely with Solutions leadership and serve as the expert on the operational sales and implementation aspects of the Mistral deal lifecycle.

You'll work closely with leadership to develop detailed pre-sales and post-sales operational plans aligned with our delivery forecasts, analyze and optimize Solutions team performance, and develop processes and KPIs to improve efficiency and support the rapid evolution of our technical pre-sales and post-sales motions.

This role is critical to driving major improvements in the efficiency and effectiveness of our Solutions team, and to using those learnings to build forward-looking capacity and delivery forecasts that integrate pre-sales requirements with best-in-class post-sale delivery and accelerate our ability to leverage Mistral to unlock value for our customers.

 

What You Will Do

 

Technical Go-to-Market Execution

• Develop frameworks to standardize how the Solutions team approaches different customer technical needs within and across segments. 

• Identify opportunities for experiment-driven improvements in the technical sales and implementation process

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Work closely with sales teams, product development, and revenue operations to align technical implementation capabilities with customer needs

• Support the development of professional services offerings and technical engagement models that maximize customer success

• Collaborate with product & engineering teams to ensure Solutions team feedback is incorporated into the product roadmap

• Help prepare materials for executive reviews highlighting technical implementation successes and challenges

 

Drive delivery excellence across the Solutions team

• Design and implement scalable frameworks and AI products that help Solutions teams consistently deliver value to clients, from pre-sales through post-sales

• Translate successful delivery patterns into repeatable, operationalized processes - reducing variability and increasing team efficiency

• Partner with technical and client-facing teams to identify friction points in delivery and build the systems to fix them

• Own the rollout of new methodologies, ensuring adoption through clear documentation, training, and change management

• Track delivery performance over time and use data to continuously improve how the team operates

 

Data-Driven Decision Support

• Identify and operationalize the right metrics to optimize the Solutions team impact on customer success & revenue

• Create and maintain reporting mechanisms around technical implementation KPIs

• Synthesize tangible, strategic recommendations that can be deployed cross-functionally

 

What We're Looking For

 

• 3+ years of experience in strategic operations, operations, chief of staff within technical sales, solutions engineering, or professional services environments.

• Proven track record in optimizing processes, impacting business KPIs, and aligning resources with business priorities.

• Exceptional negotiation and diplomacy skills: ability to navigate complex stakeholder dynamics and align competing priorities.

• Hands-on, execution-focused mindset with a bias for action in ambiguous, fast-changing environments.

• Technical acumen and AI fluency: understanding of AI implementation, use cases, and scaling challenges.

• Strong analytical skills, with experience in Salesforce, data warehouses, BI tools (e.g., Looker, Hex, BigQuery).

• Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.

• Fluency in English (native level); additional European languages are a plus.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition, North America
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

 

As a Talent Acquisition Lead on the US recruiting team, you will be instrumental in building and scaling teams at Mistral from the ground up. Joining early means you’ll help shape both our recruitment strategy and operations, partnering closely with hiring managers across technical and business units. Your work will directly influence our success by ensuring we find and engage exceptional people who will drive Mistral’s growth. In this role, you’ll also foster a strong candidate experience and help establish recruiting best practices for our US efforts.

 

What You Will Do

  • Partner with technology and business leaders to understand hiring needs and identify the right talent

  • Own end-to-end recruitment, including sourcing, interviewing, and closing candidates

  • Guide candidates through the hiring process, providing clear communication and insights into our culture

  • Develop and refine recruiting processes, tools, and documentation to improve outcomes and efficiency

  • Use data to diagnose process issues and propose solutions

  • Deliver a high-quality candidate experience in a competitive talent market

  • Collaborate with others to continuously raise the bar for our hiring standards

  • Contribute directly to defining and evolving our talent acquisition approach in the US

 

What We're Looking For

  • At least 6 years of recruiting experience, including 2+ years in a startup or high-growth company

  • Demonstrated ability to independently hire for complex roles, both technical and business

  • Experience working across multiple locations or markets

  • Comfort navigating ambiguity and switching between strategic and hands-on work

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Ability to influence peers and senior stakeholders without direct authority

  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to juggle shifting priorities

  • Professional experience with recruiting tools such as Ashby, LinkedIn Recruiter, or Modernloop

  • Track record of hiring for both business and tech roles

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: CyberSecurity, Offensive Security Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Role summary

At Mistral AI, we’re pushing the boundaries of what’s possible with agentic systems—building products like Mistral Studio and Mistral Vibe that redefine how users interact with AI.

As an Offensive Security Pentester, you’ll play a pivotal role in safeguarding these innovations by anticipating, identifying, and mitigating risks before they materialize. This isn’t just about finding vulnerabilities; it’s about shaping the future of secure AI by embedding an attacker’s mindset into everything we build.

You’ll work at the intersection of offensive security, AI safety, and product development, collaborating with cross-functional teams to harden our systems against evolving threats. Your expertise will directly influence how we design, deploy, and protect our most critical assets, ensuring our agents remain resilient, trustworthy, and ahead of adversaries.

This role is ideal for those who thrive in dynamic environments, where creativity, technical depth, and a passion for security converge to solve unprecedented challenges.

 

What you will do

 

  • Proactively hunt for vulnerabilities in the interactions between our agentic applications, cloud infrastructure, and foundational models, with a focus on realistic, high-impact attack vectors.

  • Design and execute red and purple team exercises, simulating sophisticated adversarial scenarios to stress-test our defenses and refine our detection capabilities.

  • Partner with defensive teams to translate offensive insights into actionable improvements, from detection engineering to incident response.

  • Conduct in-depth penetration testing across our product suite, including AI-driven workflows, custom infrastructure, and user-facing interfaces.

  • Build and automate offensive tooling to scale your impact, leveraging cutting-edge techniques to stay ahead of emerging threats.

  • Communicate findings with clarity and conviction, ensuring technical and non-technical stakeholders understand risks and prioritize mitigations effectively.

  • Shape Mistral AI’s security strategy by contributing attacker-informed perspectives to threat modeling, risk assessment, and architectural decisions.

 

About you

 

You’re likely a strong fit if you bring:

  • 7+ years of offensive security experience, with a track record of identifying and exploiting subtle vulnerabilities in complex systems—or equivalent expertise demonstrated through exceptional achievements.

  • Deep knowledge of AI/ML security risks, including prompt injection, data leakage, model manipulation, and abuses of dynamic UI components.

  • Hands-on experience assessing modern technology stacks, such as:

    • Custom Kubernetes deployments and containerized environments

    • Cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, or Azure)

    • CI/CD pipelines and GitHub security best practices

    • macOS/Linux internals and Python/React-based applications

    • Data science toolchains and AI/ML infrastructure

  • A builder’s mindset: The ability to write robust tools, automate offensive workflows, and contribute to defensive solutions in complex codebases.

  • Strong intuition for trust boundaries and risk assessment in fast-moving, high-stakes environments.

  • Outstanding communication skills, with the ability to distill technical nuances into compelling narratives that drive change.

  • A collaborative spirit, eager to work alongside engineers, researchers, and product teams to embed security into every phase of development.

Now, it would be ideal if you had experience with:

  • Background in AI, data science, or related fields, with an understanding of how security intersects with model behavior and system design.

  • Experience in high-growth startups or research-driven organizations, where agility and innovation are paramount.

  • Expertise in adjacent disciplines, such as software engineering, detection engineering, SRE, or security architecture.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, CyberSecurity
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Role summary

We are seeking an Applied AI Engineer to build the customer-facing cyber service and use-cases on top of our cyber harnesses. You will turn "we have agents" into "we shipped something a client uses." This role is about composing red-team/blue-team agentic workflows, configuring harnesses for real-world scenarios, and delivering value directly to clients.

Your work will bridge the gap between our foundational cyber harnesses and the agentic solutions that clients deploy. While SWE-Cyber makes the platform robust and scalable, and Pentesters run the solution and guide the direction, you will focus on building the agentic use-cases and client-facing service that solve real security problems.

 

What you will do

Client-Facing Agentic Solutions
• Compose red-team / blue-team agentic workflows for production use-cases
• Configure harnesses for cloud defense, vulnerability scanning, dynamic red-teaming, and penetration testing scenarios
• Work directly on client use-cases, translating security requirements into agentic solutions
• Turn prototype agents into deployed services that clients rely on

Context Engineering & Orchestration
• Design and implement context engineering that enables agents to operate effectively in cybersecurity domains
• Orchestrate multi-agent systems for complex security workflows
• Build the agentic layer that sits between the harness and the client

Service Delivery
• Ship fast and iterate based on client feedback and real-world performance
• Operate independently while leveraging internal building blocks and frameworks
• Collaborate with pentesters to ensure domain accuracy and effectiveness
• Partner with SWE-Cyber to ensure the platform supports your use-case requirements

 

About you

• Strong applied AI engineer with hands-on experience building agents, LLM orchestration, context engineering, evals, and RAG systems
• You ship fast, with a bias toward action and delivery

The Role

As a Talent Acquisition Specialist on the People team, you will partner with hiring managers to attract and hire exceptional people across multiple domains: GTM, Corporate, Engineering/Product, and Science. Your role exists to help shape how the team identifies, engages, and secures talent that moves the business forward—especially in challenging and competitive markets.

You’ll guide candidates through hiring processes, acting as an ambassador and ensuring a memorable experience. As an early team member, you’ll influence how recruitment is done, building systems and processes that lay the foundation for the future. You’ll work from various locations, with regular visits to Paris to connect onsite and stay close to the team.

What You Will Do

  • Partner closely with hiring managers to understand hiring needs and develop sourcing strategies

  • Attract and engage unique candidates across diverse functions and locations

  • Oversee end-to-end candidate journeys, ensuring clear communication at every stage

  • Identify and fulfill complex roles in multi-location settings

  • Analyze data to spot trends, inefficiencies, and improvement areas in talent processes

  • Propose and implement enhancements to processes, documentation, and tools

  • Collaborate to raise standards in candidate experience and recruitment effectiveness

  • Play a central role in evolving the overall talent acquisition function

What We're Looking For

  • At least 4 years of recruiting experience in demanding environments, ideally in tech or high-growth settings

  • Comfort managing searches independently in highly competitive talent markets

jobs.title: HR People Ops France
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As a People Operations Manager on the People team, you will build, scale, and maintain the operational foundation that supports our team in France. This role exists to ensure our daily HR processes run seamlessly, keeping the company fully compliant while delivering a reliable, clear, and high-quality experience for every employee.

You will act as the primary point of contact for employee lifecycle milestones, everyday operations, and external vendor relations. Your impact will be felt directly through the precision of our monthly payroll, the clarity of our internal policies, and the efficiency of our onboarding systems.

This position requires a balanced blend of hands-on administrative execution and process engineering. You will own the full operational landscape—from local labor contracts and complex immigration cases to scaling our HRIS software—while constantly identifying opportunities to automate workflows and reduce friction.

What You Will Do

  • Process payroll end-to-end for France-based employees, collaborating closely with external providers and our internal Finance team to ensure timely, precise execution.

  • Own the onboarding journey, managing labor contracts, amendments, certificates, and system updates so new hires are integrated accurately from day one.

  • Navigate immigration and mobility requests, directly managing work permits, visa renewals, and National Security Number applications.

  • Resolve daily employee inquiries regarding benefits administration, enrollment changes, and company policies with clear and prompt support.

  • Maintain compliance infrastructure, regularly updating employee handbooks and monitoring shifts in French employment law to protect the company.

  • Lead HR software initiatives and vendor management projects to evaluate, implement, and refine our HRIS and payroll tools.

  • Streamline operational workflows by documenting, automating, and auditing existing procedures to eliminate administrative bottlenecks.

What We're Looking For

  • 5 to 10 years of progressive HR experience, ideally within a startup or high-growth environment, alongside a degree in HR, Business Administration, or a related field.

  • Deep operational knowledge of French labor laws, local employment regulations, national payroll structures, and tax compliance.

  • Proven experience managing the entire employee lifecycle from onboarding through retention strategies to formal offboarding.

  • Technical proficiency with modern HR technology solutions, including HRIS platforms and automated payroll tools.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret regulatory updates into practical internal policies.

  • A practical, hands-on execution style combined with a builder mindset—you genuinely enjoy creating order out of ambiguity and setting up scalable systems.

  • Clear, direct communication and interpersonal skills to manage sensitive employee topics and coordinate effectively with external vendors.

 

 

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

As a Senior People Operations Manager on the People team, you will build, scale, and manage the operational infrastructure that supports our team in North America and drives our international expansion. This role exists to ensure our regional HR operations run seamlessly, keeping the company fully compliant while executing a high-touch, reliable support system for our growing team.

You will lead the end-to-end employee lifecycle operations for the region, managing everything from North American payroll and local benefits to complex global mobility and visa tracking. Your impact will be felt directly through your ability to establish compliant HR frameworks in entirely new countries and streamline our internal operational workflows.

This position requires a balance of strategic process engineering and hands-on administrative execution. You will own the operational foundation—ensuring data integrity across our HRIS software, building scalable vendor partnerships, and addressing daily employee inquiries with a strong service-oriented approach.

What You Will Do

  • Manage and process payroll for all employees across the North America region, partnering with local providers and internal Finance teams to ensure precise, on-time execution.

  • Launch HR operations in new countries, deploying localized employee benefits programs, setting up compliant entities, and establishing local operational policies.

  • Own the onboarding and lifecycle documentation, formalizing labor contracts, amendments, and internal status changes securely within our HRIS.

  • Coordinate global mobility and immigration, directly managing visas for new hires and navigating compliance requirements for international team work trips.

  • Resolve daily employee inquiries regarding benefits enrollment, policy clarifications, and routine payroll changes with clear and timely communication.

  • Audit and optimize internal HR workflows, identifying opportunities for software automation and benchmarking external vendors to maximize administrative efficiency.

  • Maintain core compliance frameworks, keeping employee handbooks up to date and monitoring regional shifts in employment regulations to protect the company.

What We're Looking For

  • 8 to 15 years of progressive HR experience, ideally within a high-growth environment, alongside a degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.

  • Strong knowledge of US employment laws, compliance regulations, and a deep understanding of regional and international payroll and tax regulations.

  • Proven experience managing the full employee lifecycle and successfully deploying benefits and HR compliance structures in new international regions.

  • High technical proficiency with modern HRIS systems, automated payroll platforms, and operational data tracking tools.

jobs.title: Head of Analyst Relations
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

We are seeking a Head of Analyst Relations to build and lead Mistral's global Analyst Relations program.

This is a foundational leadership role responsible for shaping how the world's most influential industry analysts understand Mistral, our products, and our long-term vision. We are establishing a new AI category, private AI for mission-critical use. And we are giving customers ownership of their AI with open weights, powerful tools to control and connect the AI, and the ability to deploy it wherever they want, from edge to cloud to dedicated sovereign hosting. Our analyst partners will help create this category, explain its importance, and guide the customers that need it. We need you to help them help us!

You will serve as a strategic advisor to executives and partner closely with Marketing, Communications, Product, Sales, and Leadership to ensure Mistral is positioned effectively across the analyst ecosystem.

You will own relationships with firms such as Gartner, IDC, Forrester, Futurum, Moor Insights, Constellation, and more to help establish Mistral as a category-defining company in artificial intelligence.

This role reports into the CMO and works closely with the executive leadership team.

What You'll Do

  • Develop and execute Mistral's global Analyst Relations program.

  • Build trusted relationships with leading industry analysts across AI, cloud, infrastructure, and enterprise software.

  • Shape and influence analyst perceptions of Mistral's products, vision, and market position.

  • Lead analyst engagement programs, including briefings, inquiries, advisory sessions, and major report submissions.

  • Partner with Product Marketing to craft differentiated messaging and category narratives.

  • Drive participation in key analyst evaluations, including Magic Quadrants, Waves, Marketscapes, and other relevant reports.

  • Translate analyst insights into actionable recommendations for leadership, Product, Marketing, and Sales teams.

  • Establish KPIs and reporting mechanisms to measure the impact of Analyst Relations across awareness, perception, and commercial outcomes.

  • Build and scale the Analyst Relations function as Mistral continues its global expansion.

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years of experience in Analyst Relations, Product Marketing, Communications, or related functions within technology companies. Experience in AR and other marketing or product disciplines is preferred.

  • Deep understanding of the analyst ecosystem and experience managing relationships with leading firms.

  • Experience supporting high-growth B2B technology or AI organizations.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Sales, and Executive Leadership.

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with a high degree of autonomy.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

jobs.title: AI Deployment Strategist, Science - EMEA
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As an AI Deployment Strategist with Science Focus, you will drive the adoption and deployment of Mistral's AI solutions for science-heavy projects, working closely with customers from strategic vision to production implementation in domains like computer vision, robotics, and embodied AI.

This role sits at the intersection of deep technical expertise, business strategy, and hands-on deployment, ensuring our customers achieve transformative outcomes in specialized AI applications.

You will partner with senior executives to design AI roadmaps for science-driven use cases, collaborate with the Applied AI and Research teams to deliver solutions in production, and ensure seamless transitions from presales to postsales. Your work will directly contribute to expanding Mistral's capabilities in cutting-edge AI domains.

This role is ideal for those who thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy solving complex technical challenges in specialized domains, and are passionate about turning AI science into real-world impact.

 

What You Will Do

Strategic Discovery & Vision Setting

  • Lead executive-level workshops to identify science-specific business challenges and opportunities where Mistral's AI can drive step-change improvements in vision, robotics, embodied AI, and other specialized domains.

  • Co-create AI adoption roadmaps with customers, articulating the "art of the possible" in science applications and a clear path to value.

  • Collaborate with Account Executives to develop business cases for technically complex, science-driven solutions, quantify ROI, and align with customer objectives.

AI Solution Design & Deployment (Science Focus)

  • Architect end-to-end AI solutions for specialized domains, integrating Mistral's models and platform into science-specific workflows and technical infrastructure.

  • Partner with the Applied AI and Research teams to design, prototype, and deploy science-focused AI solutions in production, ensuring scalability and impact.

  • Own the execution of science-heavy pilot projects and proofs-of-value, demonstrating the potential of our technology in specialized domains and paving the way for full-scale deployment.

Value Realization & Customer Success

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to customers on science-driven AI strategies, ensuring they maximize the value of their investment in Mistral's specialized capabilities.

  • Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) tied to technical and business outcomes in science domains, and communicate progress to executive sponsors.

  • Proactively identify expansion opportunities within accounts for science applications, building on initial successes to drive long-term partnerships.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Act as the bridge between customers and Mistral's Research and Applied AI teams, synthesizing feedback to influence science-focused product and research roadmaps.

  • Develop reusable assets, best practices, and playbooks for science domain deployments to scale go-to-market efforts.

  • Travel (~30-60%) to foster deep client relationships and support on-site deployment of specialized solutions.

 

 

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years in a client-facing technical role (e.g., data science consulting, research engineering, or technical sales) with strong background in AI science domains (computer vision, robotics, embodied AI, etc.)

  • You hold a degree in a scientific field (e.g., Computer Science, Robotics, Physics, Mathematics) - PhD is a plus

  • Deep technical knowledge of AI/ML/Data Science with specialization in science domains, and the credibility to advise highly technical audiences

  • Hands-on experience building and deploying science-focused AI applications (Python, C++, or similar) to demonstrate value in specialized domains

  • Strong business acumen and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business value

  • Executive presence and communication skills to influence senior stakeholders (VP, C-level) on technically advanced solutions

  • Hands-on experience building and deploying AI applications (Python) in science domains

  • Resilient, results-driven, and comfortable leading through influence in a highly technical, collaborative environment

  • Experience with research-to-production transitions and working with research teams is a plus

Why This Role Matters You will play a pivotal role in shaping how enterprises adopt and deploy AI, ensuring Mistral’s solutions deliver measurable impact. By partnering with the Applied AI team, you’ll help turn strategic visions into production-ready solutions, making Mistral an indispensable partner for our customers.

 
 

Hiring Process

 

• Talent Acquisition screening call

• 30min Hiring Manager Interview

• 45min Business Acumen Interview 

• 60min Technical Deep Dive on LLMs

• Panel (Home Prep & Restitution)

• 30min Value Talk

• Reference check

 

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Engineering Team Lead, DevEx
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Role summary

 

On average, our team leads are responsible for teams of about five people, owning both execution and delivery while remaining hands-on. You will split your time dynamically between individual contribution and leadership, with the balance shifting as your team grows.

 

You will collaborate closely with engineering teams to ship improvements that directly accelerate development velocity, enhance code quality, and streamline workflows across our AI platform and products: AI Studio, Le Chat, and Mistral Vibe. You will be responsible for creating a strong team culture, setting clear processes, raising the developer experience bar, and ensuring consistent high-quality delivery of developer tooling and infrastructure.

 

This is a highly critical role at the intersection of developer productivity, infrastructure, and people. You will help shape how our engineering organization builds at scale. If you enjoy building developer platforms, leading ambitious engineers, and shipping tooling that supercharges productivity, this role is for you.

 

What you will do

 

• Empower Your Team: Act as the clear point of contact for your team and its projects. Remove obstacles, unblock execution, and create an environment where engineers can focus on building impactful developer tools and platforms.

 

• Lead Delivery and Accountability: Own the delivery of your team’s roadmap for developer experience improvements, including projects like enhancing CI/CD and build systems, optimizing cloud registries (Docker, Azure, GCP), implementing static and dynamic code analysis tools, and automated vulnerability analysis. Ensure projects are shipped with the right level of quality, reliability, and performance.

 

• Bridge Engineering and Productivity: Partner closely with engineering teams to define the roadmap and priorities for developer experience. Scope initiatives, estimate engineering effort, and drive prioritization decisions based on developer productivity impact and technical necessity. Keep the whole team involved and engaged in the product direction.

 

• Hands-on Technical Leadership: Stay deeply involved in architecture design, system design, coding, peer reviews, and technical decision-making for developer tooling. Lead by example and remain connected to the day-to-day challenges of the team.

 

• Process and Clarity: Define and evolve team processes, best practices, and execution rituals for developer workflows. Ensure they remain relevant as the team and product scale.

 

• Raise the bar: Challenge engineers to step up, take ownership, and grow beyond their comfort zone. Increase the team’s bus factor through knowledge sharing, documentation, and rotation of responsibilities. Champion a culture of continuous improvement in developer productivity.

 
 

About you

 

• 5+ years of relevant professional work experience in Developer Experience (DevEx), DevOps, or related fields.

• Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

• Proficiency in scripting and programming languages (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go) and experience with infrastructure as code tools.

• Experience with building and leading high-performing teams in developer tooling or infrastructure.

• Experience working with cross-functional teams including product, design, and business.

• Experience with project management and planning for infrastructure and tooling initiatives.

• Ownership and capacity to ship developer tooling and platforms end-to-end.

• Strong experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins), cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure), build systems, container registries, and developer tooling.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Account Executive, Enterprise
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

 

As our Account Executive Enterprise, you will be instrumental in shaping Mistral’s adoption with our largest customers across a variety of industry.

You will be driving deals end2end: from prospective, first intro call until closing and beyond — together with our dedicated implementation specialist, tech and legal teams.

 

What You Will Do:

 

Lead development (strategic outbound and qualified inbound):

- Handle strategic outreach as well as warm introductions to promising enterprise customers

- Converting inbound deals where upselling / more bespoke agreements can be achieved

 

Value prop validation for customer:

- Provide hands-on support and guidance to clients during a potential Proof of Concept (POC) phase, ensuring a smooth and successful evaluation process

- Leverage successful POC outcomes to facilitate the conversion of POCs into long-term, revenue-generating contracts

 

Deal management & closing:

- Develop and execute strategic sales plans to convert leads into valued customers — you are the first point of contact for all external stakeholders and are responsible for properly managing deals and aligning all stakeholders (heavy involvement of customer engineering, product, and commercial teams, both on operational and C-level)

- Handle customer negotiation end2end, together with our legal and implementation specialist team

 

Executive Engagement:

- Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with C-level executives, heads of innovation/AI, and other key decision-makers within target organisations

- Comprehend their specific challenges and needs, positioning our solution as an integral part of their strategic initiatives

 

Technical Aptitude:

- Demonstrate a deep understanding of the technical intricacies of our product and articulate its value proposition effectively to potential clients

- Work side-by-side with our implementation team to ensure that customer’s questions, concerns and challenges are taken care of during pre-sales, deployment and post-deployment phase

- Collaborate with our technical team to address any customer inquiries or concerns

 

Training and enablement:

-Empower internal teams with the knowledge and resources that you collect in customer conversations to drive product roadmap and align on priorities

 

What We're Looking For:

 

- 7-10 years experience in Sales for diverse industry (enterprise sales/consultative selling, ideally selling a highly complex, technical product)

- Excellent academics: Bachelor and/or Master Degree in Business, Computer Science, or a related field

- Significant work experience within AI ecosystem or related data/infrastructure field

- Experience at successful fast growing startup, ideally in deep-tech

- Strong technical skills to navigate quickly evolving products and steer technical discussions

- Excellent English & French, additional language welcome (e.g. German, Spanish, etc.)

- Outstanding negotiation and communication skills

 

What We Offer:

 

💰 Competitive cash salary and equity

🥕 Food : Daily lunch vouchers

🥎 Sport : Monthly contribution to a Gym pass subscription

🚴 Transportation : Monthly contribution to a mobility pass

🧑‍⚕ Health : Full health insurance for you and your family

🍼 Parental : Generous parental leave policy

🌎 Visa sponsorship

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

The Role

 

We are looking for an experienced Legal Counsel to support Mistral AI’s GDPR compliance strategy by being the product and engineering teams' closest partner and advisor, and drafting compliance documentation.

 

The legal team currently comprises 15 persons across Paris and Palo Alto, covering a spectrum of competences across regulatory, IP, contracts and corporate.

 
 

What You Will Do

 

Support Mistral AI’s GDPR compliance

• Manage Mistral AI’s compliance documentation (records of processing of personal data, data privacy impact assessments, internal policies, etc.)

• Answer and manage data subject requests;  Implement GDPR processes and automation

• Manage employee training on privacy topics

• Negotiate DPAs with Mistral AI’s providers and customers

• Monitor privacy regulations and supervisory authorities guidance or decisions

 

Advise other teams on privacy topics

• Advise the product team on privacy topics concerning new features

• Answer privacy-related questions from other teams

• Update the compliance documentation accordingly

 
 

What We're Looking For

 

• Background : Master degree in law, a bar admission is a plus, as well as an experience in a fast-growing environment

• Experience: 3 to 5 years of experience in a law firm or in a tech company, in IT law and specifically in privacy law and GDPR compliance

• Knowledge of privacy law: The candidate has a good knowledge of privacy regulations and guidance from national supervisory authorities as well as the EDPB

• Knowledge of Artificial Intelligence: An understanding of artificial intelligence technologies and their applications is essential

• Solution oriented approach: The ideal candidate should be able to identify compliance issues and develop effective strategies to address and resolve them. They should be capable of implementing practical solutions

• Project management: The candidate has good project management skills

• Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze complex legal and technical issues related to AI and to identify potential legal risks and solutions is important. Candidates should be detail-oriented and have strong problem-solving skills

• Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication; Strong ability to present complex legal concepts in a clear and understandable manner. Business oriented

• International mindset: An international experience is a plus

• Adaptability: Given the rapidly evolving nature of AI technologies and the legal landscape surrounding them, candidates should be adaptable and willing to continuously learn and update their skills and knowledge. Ability to work independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment. Proactive, flexible, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

We are looking for an experienced Legal Counsel to support Mistral AI’s GDPR compliance strategy by being the product and engineering teams' closest partner and advisor, and drafting compliance documentation.

 

The legal team currently comprises 15 persons across Paris and Palo Alto, covering a spectrum of competences across regulatory, IP, contracts and corporate.

 
 

What You Will Do

 

Support Mistral AI’s GDPR compliance

• Manage Mistral AI’s compliance documentation (records of processing of personal data, data privacy impact assessments, internal policies, etc.)

• Answer and manage data subject requests;  Implement GDPR processes and automation

• Manage employee training on privacy topics

• Negotiate DPAs with Mistral AI’s providers and customers

• Monitor privacy regulations and supervisory authorities guidance or decisions

 

Advise other teams on privacy topics

• Advise the product team on privacy topics concerning new features

• Answer privacy-related questions from other teams

• Update the compliance documentation accordingly

 
 

What We're Looking For

 

• Background : Master degree in law, a bar admission is a plus, as well as an experience in a fast-growing environment

• Knowledge of Artificial Intelligence: An understanding of artificial intelligence technologies and their applications is essential

jobs.title: RFP & Bid Manager, AI Solutions
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role


As we expand across the MEA region, the volume and complexity of RFPs will only increase. You will play a pivotal role in ensuring our proposals are compliant, competitive, and compelling, while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to deliver winning bids.

What You Will Do

1. RFP & Bid Management

  • Lead the end-to-end response process for RFPs, RFIs, and RFQs, ensuring high-quality, on-time submissions.

  • Coordinate inputs from sales, product, engineering, legal, security, and delivery teams to craft cohesive, client-focused proposals.

  • Ensure all responses meet customer requirements and deadlines, with zero tolerance for compliance gaps.

  • Develop and maintain a library of reusable RFP content, including AI capabilities, technical architecture, security, and compliance documentation.

2. Commercial Deal Support

  • Partner with GTM leadership to structure scalable AI solutions that align with pricing models and client needs.

  • Support the creation of:

    • Statements of Work (SoW)

    • Delivery plans and resource assumptions

    • Cost models and commercial frameworks

3. Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Act as the central hub between GTM/Sales, Product, Engineering/Research, Legal & Compliance, and Delivery/Professional Services.

  • Ensure proposals accurately reflect product capabilities, roadmap alignment, and client expectations.

What We're Looking For

  • Experienced: Proven track record in RFP/bid management, preferably in AI, tech, or public sector environments. Experience in the Middle East AND European RFP (EU Institutions, National Governments) is a plus.

  • Detail-Oriented: Exceptional ability to manage multiple deadlines, prioritize tasks, and maintain meticulous documentation.

  • Collaborative: Strong interpersonal skills to align diverse stakeholders and drive consensus.

  • Strategic: Ability to translate technical and commercial requirements into persuasive, client-centric proposals.

  • Adaptable: Thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with evolving priorities.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Familiarity with public sector tenders (MEA region experience is a plus).

  • Background in AI, cloud computing, or enterprise software.

  • Fluency in English (additional languages, e.g., Arabic or French, are advantageous)

Why Join Us?

  • Impact: Shape the future of AI adoption in the MEA region by winning transformational deals.

  • Growth: Work alongside a talented, ambitious team in a dynamic, innovative company.

  • Ownership: Take end-to-end ownership of bids that drive revenue and market expansion.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Legal Counsel, Banking / Financing
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Role Summary 

 

As our Banking / Financing Legal Counsel, you will work side by side with our corporate counsel and directly under the Head of M&A and Finance Legal Counsel, based in Paris. 

In close collaboration with our Finance and Business teams, you will be instrumental in structuring, drafting, and negotiating the financing transactions that fuel Mistral's external growth — from compute infrastructure and data center investments to strategic company acquisitions.

Key responsibilities

Financing Transactions

 

• Structure, draft, negotiate, and close transaction documentation on non-dilutive financing transactions, including corporate loans, asset-backed financings, and project finance deals supporting our infrastructure and compute investments.

• Act as the primary legal point of contact for banking and financing counterparties, working with LMA-standard documentation and bespoke structures alike.

• Advise on financing structures for data center and compute infrastructure projects.

• Coordinate with external law firms on cross-border financing structures and manage multi-jurisdictional transaction teams.

 

Cross-functional Partnership

 

• Partner daily with the Finance team (Treasury, FP&A) to ensure financing solutions are aligned with Mistral's capital strategy and operational needs.

• Collaborate with M&A, Compute, and Business teams to support deal-specific financing structures.

• Provide practical, hands-on legal guidance that enables the business to move fast while limiting legal risks.

Legal Infrastucture

• Build and maintain internal templates, precedents, and guidelines for financing documentation.

• Support on ancillary legal topics as needed, including corporate compliance, insurance, and Sapin II-related matters.

Qualifications and skills

 

• Bachelor degree or above (LLB, LLM, Juris Doctor preferred) from an accredited law school in France or another EU country. Admission to practice law in at least one other jurisdiction, in particular in the USA, would be a plus.

• A minimum of 7 years of relevant legal experience, including a minimum of 4 years in an international law firm.

• Proven track record in structuring and negotiating non-dilutive financing deals, including corporate loans, bridge facilities, asset-backed and project finance transactions. Familiarity with LMA standard documentation is required.

• Strong experience in project finance or infrastructure financing, particularly deals involving long-term capex or compute and data center infrastructure, is highly valued.

• Demonstrated ability to navigate cross-border structuring questions and multi-jurisdictional financing deals, including coordinating with local external counsel.

• Excellent written and verbal communication in both English and French. Strong ability to present complex legal concepts in a clear and understandable manner to non-legal stakeholders.

• Sharp business acumen, honed through direct experience working within businesses — ideally across multiple industries — where you have delivered measurable impact and demonstrated a deep understanding of operational and strategic priorities.

• Great negotiation skills, with a history of successfully leading critical discussions with banks, investors, and infrastructure partners, balancing assertiveness with collaboration, and maintaining positive, long-term relationships with all stakeholders.

• An understanding of the tax implications of financing and structuring, allowing you to optimise outcomes and mitigate risks.

• Knowledge and usage of Artificial Intelligence: an understanding of AI technologies, including machine learning, natural language processing and their applications, is important.

• Analytical Skills: ability to analyse complex cross-border structuring questions, their interactions with financing topics, and to identify potential legal risks and solutions.

• Adaptability: proactive, flexible, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Ethical Awareness: a strong understanding of ethical considerations related to AI, such as fairness, transparency, accountability, and bias mitigation, is important.

• International mindset: international experience is a plus.

 
 

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

Role Summary

As our Developer Education Lead, you will define the strategic vision for all technical documentation at Mistral AI. Your responsibilities include:

  • Structuring and standardizing technical content to ensure quality, consistency, and alignment with the needs of users, developers, and partners.

  • Building and leading a team of technical writers, collaborating closely with Product, Engineering, and Support teams.

  • Driving editorial and technical excellence, while optimizing tools and processes for scalable, high-impact documentation.

  • Reporting directly to the VP of Engineering, ensuring documentation aligns with technical and product priorities.

What you will do

Strategic Leadership

  • Define and execute a comprehensive documentation strategy aligned with product roadmaps and business objectives.

  • Develop a forward-looking vision for documentation, anticipating the needs of diverse audiences, including developers, enterprises, and researchers.

  • Advocate for users in product and technical discussions.

Team Management

  • Recruit, mentor, and develop a team of technical writers.

  • Prioritize documentation projects based on business impact and user feedback.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure documentation supports product development, onboarding, and customer success.

  • Partner with Engineering to adopt a "docs-as-code" approach, embedding documentation early in the development lifecycle.

  • Participate in technical reviews to maintain accuracy and relevance.

Standardization & Innovation

  • Create and enforce guidelines for tone, structure, and accessibility across all documentation (APIs, SDKs, tutorials, release notes, FAQs, etc.).

  • Streamline content creation, updates, and localization using modern tools (Markdown, Git, headless CMS, generative AI).

  • Identify documentation gaps and propose innovative solutions, such as interactive guides or chatbot integration.

Quality & Impact

  • Deliver clear, precise, and adaptable content for technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Track and analyze documentation effectiveness through metrics, user feedback, and support ticket resolution rates.

  • Promote best practices and provide training across the organization.

Continuous Improvement

  • Stay updated on trends in technical documentation, including AI, localization, and UX writing.

  • Benchmark against industry standards and implement improvements, such as dynamic content personalization.

About you

Experience

  • 10+ years in technical writing /developer education, with 3+ years leading teams or defining documentation strategies (AI, SaaS, or complex software preferred).

  • Proven ability to develop and implement scalable documentation strategies.

  • Experience with AI/ML concepts is a strong plus.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in Markdown, Git, and technical CMS (e.g., Docusaurus, Sphinx).

  • Familiarity with collaboration tools (Notion, Confluence) and analytics platforms (Google Analytics, Hotjar).

  • Fluent English (primary working language); French is a bonus.

Soft Skills

  • Strong leadership to inspire teams and align stakeholders.

  • Ability to simplify complex concepts for diverse audiences.

  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and thrives in fast-paced environments.

  • Collaborative mindset, comfortable working with both technical and non-technical teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a scale-up or open-source environment.

  • Knowledge of GDPR and European doc

 

Location & Remote

 

This role is based in one of our European offices (Paris, France and London, UK). We will only consider candidates who either reside or are open to relocating there. We strongly believe in the value of in-person collaboration and we encourage going to the office as much as we can (at least 3 days per week) to create bonds and smooth communication. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.




ROLE SUMMARY

As our Developer Education Lead, you will define the strategic vision for all technical documentation at Mistral AI. Your responsibilities include:

 - Structuring and standardizing technical content to ensure quality, consistency, and alignment with the needs of users, developers, and partners.

 - Building and leading a team of technical writers, collaborating closely with Product, Engineering, and Support teams.

 - Driving editorial and technical excellence, while optimizing tools and processes for scalable, high-impact documentation.

 - Reporting directly to the VP of Engineering, ensuring documentation aligns with technical and product priorities.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

Strategic Leadership

 - Define and execute a comprehensive documentation strategy aligned with product roadmaps and business objectives.

 - Develop a forward-looking vision for documentation, anticipating the needs of diverse audiences, including developers, enterprises, and researchers.

 - Advocate for users in product and technical discussions.

Team Management

 - Recruit, mentor, and develop a team of technical writers.

 - Prioritize documentation projects based on business impact and user feedback.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

 - Work closely with Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure documentation supports product development, onboarding, and customer success.

 - Partner with Engineering to adopt a "docs-as-code" approach, embedding documentation early in the development lifecycle.

 - Participate in technical reviews to maintain accuracy and relevance.

Standardization & Innovation

 - Create and enforce guidelines for tone, structure, and accessibility across all documentation (APIs, SDKs, tutorials, release notes, FAQs, etc.).

 - Streamline content creation, updates, and localization using modern tools (Markdown, Git, headless CMS, generative AI).

 - Identify documentation gaps and propose innovative solutions, such as interactive guides or chatbot integration.

Quality & Impact

 - Deliver clear, precise, and adaptable content for technical and non-technical audiences.

 - Track and analyze documentation effectiveness through metrics, user feedback, and support ticket resolution rates.

 - Promote best practices and provide training across the organization.

Continuous Improvement

 - Stay updated on trends in technical documentation, including AI, localization, and UX writing.

 - Benchmark against industry standards and implement improvements, such as dynamic content personalization.


ABOUT YOU

Experience

 - 10+ years in technical writing /developer education, with 3+ years leading teams or defining documentation strategies (AI, SaaS, or complex software preferred).

 - Proven ability to develop and implement scalable documentation strategies.

 - Experience with AI/ML concepts is a strong plus.

Technical Skills

 - Proficiency in Markdown, Git, and technical CMS (e.g., Docusaurus, Sphinx).

 - Familiarity with collaboration tools (Notion, Confluence) and analytics platforms (Google Analytics, Hotjar).

 - Fluent English (primary working language); French is a bonus.

Soft Skills

 - Strong leadership to inspire teams and align stakeholders.

 - Ability to simplify complex concepts for diverse audiences.

 - Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and thrives in fast-paced environments.

 - Collaborative mindset, comfortable working with both technical and non-technical teams.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience in a scale-up or open-source environment.

 - Knowledge of GDPR and European doc

 

Location & Remote

 

This role is based in one of our European offices (Paris, France and London, UK). We will only consider candidates who either reside or are open to relocating there. We strongly believe in the value of in-person collaboration and we encourage going to the office as much as we can (at least 3 days per week) to create bonds and smooth communication. Our remote policy aims to provide flexibility, improve work-life balance and increase productivity.





WHAT WE OFFER

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As our Senior Technical Writer / Developer Educator, you will drive the quality, technical accuracy, and clarity of developer-facing documentation at Mistral AI.

This is an individual contributor role focused on hands-on excellence, strategic content design, and ensuring that developers can successfully integrate with and deploy Mistral products. You will work closely with Engineering, Product, and Support teams, combining technical validation with compelling storytelling to create documentation that developers love.

What You Will Do

Technical Documentation & Strategy

  • Author and maintain high-quality, technically accurate documentation for APIs, SDKs, tutorials, deployment guides, and release notes

  • Contribute to documentation strategy and content roadmap, identifying gaps and proposing solutions

  • Develop a clear, consistent editorial voice and narrative approach across documentation

  • Create information architecture and content structures for complex technical topics, especially on-premises deployment scenarios

Hands-On Technical Validation

  • Test all APIs, features, and deployment workflows before documenting

  • Validate documentation by reproducing user workflows; catch inaccuracies, edge cases, and unclear instructions before publication

  • Experiment with and understand the technical depth needed for both self-serve and on-premises documentation

  • Own the responsibility that what you ship works, is testable, and solves real developer problems

Collaboration & Cross-Functional Impact

  • Work closely with Engineering and Product to understand feature scope, technical requirements, and deployment complexities

  • Participate in technical reviews, design discussions, and release planning to ensure documentation is integrated early

  • Gather feedback from Support, DevRel, and users to identify documentation pain points and opportunities

  • Advocate for clarity and user experience in product design and documentation decisions

Quality, Consistency & Standards

  • Help define and enforce tone guidelines, content standards, and documentation best practices

  • Ensure consistency in terminology, voice, and narrative across documentation—self-serve vs. on-premises, API reference vs. tutorials

  • Document as if you're telling a story: show why a feature matters, what problem it solves, not just how it works

  • Use modern documentation tools and practices—Markdown, Git, headless CMS, and AI tools—to streamline production


What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years in technical writing, developer documentation, or developer education (SaaS, APIs, infrastructure, or AI/ML preferred)

  • Proven ability to write for technical audiences—APIs, deployment guides, code examples, system architecture

  • Experience validating technical accuracy through hands-on testing and experimentation

  • Comfortable with Markdown, Git, and technical documentation tools (Docusaurus, Sphinx, or similar)

  • Experience with API testing and validation (Postman, curl, or REST clients)

  • Familiarity with code examples, including Python, JavaScript, or CLI workflows

  • Ability to understand and test complex deployment scenarios (Docker, Kubernetes, on-premises infrastructure a plus)

  • Fluent English (primary working language); French is a bonus

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.
