jobs.title: Technical Marketing Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About the Role

As a Technical Marketing Engineer (TME), you will bridge the gap between Mistral's science/engineering organisations and our marketing teams. You will create technical content to educate enterprise decision-makers, align technical capabilities with business goals, and accelerate sales cycles. Your role is critical in simplifying complex technical concepts, building trust, and driving adoption of our AI solutions.

 

What You Will Do

Create and Deliver Technical Content:

Develop model/product technical launch materials, technical proof points, presentation decks, demo videos, webinars, workshops, blogs, whitepapers, and sales training materials.

Enable Sales and Partners:

Equip sales teams and partners with technical knowledge to engage in deeper, more credible conversations with technical stakeholders.

Support Model Launches:

Collaborate on model launches, ensuring technical messaging is clear and impactful.

Engage with Analysts and Industry Leaders:

Participate in analyst briefings, technical advisory boards (TABs), and industry standards discussions to position Mistral AI as a thought leader.

Build Trust and Drive Adoption:

Work with solutions architects and developer relations to ensure seamless integration and implementation of our solutions through targeted technical content.

Interface with Science and Engineering:

Act as the technical liaison between engineering, science, and marketing teams, translating complex LLM concepts (including pre-training and post-training techniques) into actionable insights for enterprise audiences.

 

Who You Are

Experience: 

- 3+ years in technical marketing, solutions engineering, or a similar role, preferably in AI/ML or enterprise software.

- Experience with large language models (LLMs), including pre-training and post-training techniques, is a strong plus.

 

Technical Skills:

- Ability to understand and communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Familiarity with enterprise AI solutions, cloud environments, and technical sales enablement.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a knack for storytelling and simplifying complexity.

 

Mindset:

- Collaborative, creative, and low-ego.

- Passionate about AI and its potential to transform industries.

 

Academic Background: 

Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is preferred.

 

It Would Be Ideal If You:

- Have hands-on experience with AI/ML models, especially in a technical marketing or solutions engineering capacity.

- Are comfortable working in a fast-paced, innovative environment and thrive in cross-functional teams.

- Have a track record of creating technical content that drives adoption and accelerates sales cycles.

- Are based in or willing to relocate to Paris, EU OR are open to regular travel to our Paris office. 

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Head of Partner Marketing
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Role Summary

As our first Partner Marketing Lead, you will define and execute the global partner marketing strategy for a company at the forefront of the enterprise AI ecosystem. You will own how we position, activate, and scale partnerships across ISVs, SIs, and cloud alliances. Your mission is to establish and scale a world-class partner marketing engine, bridging infrastructure partners, ISVs, and open AI communities to drive joint GTM success and measurable revenue impact. 

This is a unique opportunity to join a high-growth company at the forefront of AI innovation, where your work will directly impact our market position and revenue growth. You’ll collaborate with world-class AI science, product, engineering, and go-to-market (GTM) teams, gaining a front-row seat to the rapidly evolving AI landscape. 

What you will do

• Lead Global Partner Marketing Strategy: Develop and execute a unified partner marketing strategy across ISVs, SIs, and cloud alliances, grounded in clear segmentation and value propositions.

• Build and Execute GTM Programs: Design and launch tiered co-marketing programs that drive measurable pipeline and influence for priority partners.

• Develop Scalable Frameworks: Create and operationalize a global partner marketing framework, including shared messaging, assets, campaign playbooks, and performance tracking.

• Drive Joint Customer Storytelling: Spearhead joint customer case studies and narratives showcasing technology integration and customer value.

• Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Strengthen collaboration with Partner, Sales, Business Development, and Product GTM teams to align partner initiatives with growth priorities.

• Instrument Performance Tracking: Track and report on partner marketing performance, including influenced pipeline, activation rates, and ecosystem share of voice.

Who you are: 

• You have 10+ years of marketing experience, with 5+ years focused on partner, alliance, or ecosystem leadership in enterprise or AI technology.

• Deep understanding of the modern AI stack. Familiarity with ecosystem dynamics across hyperscalers, model providers, and open-source platforms.

• Proven track record in leading global partner or ecosystem marketing in high-growth enterprise or AI-native environments. Skilled in cross-functional orchestration and C-level communication.

• Strong GTM and partner marketing strategy skills, with a data-driven approach to pipeline influence, campaign ROI, and partner engagement metrics.

• Thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and are comfortable with ambiguity and changing priorities.

• Excellent cross-functional leadership and communication skills, adept at aligning Product, Business Development, and Marketing teams.

• Willing to travel (~25-40%)

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

jobs.title: AI Deployment Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Role Summary

 

As a AI Deployment Lead, you will bridge the gap between vision and execution, ensuring our customers not only see the potential of AI but realize its value in their operations. This role is a unique blend of strategic advisory and hands-on deployment leadership, spanning both presales and postsales phases. You will act as a trusted advisor to C-suite executives, architecting AI solutions that drive transformation and delivering measurable business outcomes.

 

You will be embedded in our most strategic accounts, diagnosing business challenges, designing AI-powered solutions, and leading their deployment from concept to full-scale adoption. This role demands a rare combination of executive presence, technical credibility, and commercial acumen, with a focus on both winning and delivering high-impact AI initiatives.

 

What you will do

 

Strategic Advisory & C-Suite Partnership

• Serve as the lead strategic advisor for a portfolio of high-value enterprise clients, building trusted relationships with executive leadership (CEO, CTO, CIO).

• Lead C-suite workshops to diagnose business drivers and co-create multi-year AI transformation roadmaps aligned with corporate strategy.

• Develop and present compelling business cases and proposals, articulating the ROI of AI adoption and the value of Mistral’s platform.

 

Presales: Shaping the Vision

• Partner with sales and product teams to identify and qualify opportunities, positioning Mistral’s solutions as the catalyst for enterprise transformation.

• Design tailored AI strategies and proof-of-concepts that address critical business challenges and demonstrate tangible value.

• Act as a subject matter expert in client engagements, ensuring our solutions are understood, trusted, and adopted.

 

Postsales: Driving Deployment & Adoption

• Own the end-to-end success of AI deployments, from strategic planning to operational integration, ensuring solutions are embedded into the customer’s core workflows.

• Lead cross-functional teams of engineers, data scientists, and product managers to execute deployment roadmaps and deliver measurable results.

• Navigate organizational complexity and drive change management to ensure seamless adoption and long-term success.

 

Commercial Growth & Thought Leadership

• Identify and cultivate expansion opportunities within accounts, connecting Mistral’s capabilities to new business challenges and driving commercial growth.

• Mentor junior strategists and contribute to the development of best practices, methodologies, and playbooks for customer engagement.

• Represent Mistral AI as a thought leader through speaking engagements, executive briefings, and industry contributions.

 
 

About you

 

• You have 8+ years of experience in technical management consulting, enterprise technology, or a customer-facing strategic role, with a focus on AI/ML, data architecture, or digital transformation.

• You hold a degree in a relevant scientific field (e.g., Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, etc.)

• You possess a deep, practical expertise in AI/ML concepts, enterprise data architecture, and modern software development with hands-on development of AI solutions—enough to credibly engage with technical teams and executives alike.

• You have a proven track record of engaging and influencing C-suite executives, with the ability to navigate complex conversations and align AI strategies with business objectives.

• You excel at structuring ambiguous problems into actionable programs and thrive in fast-paced, high-stakes environments.

• You are equally comfortable in presales and postsales: shaping deals, designing solutions, and ensuring their successful deployment.

• You have experience managing high-value accounts, understanding deal mechanics, and building compelling cases for investment.

• You are a collaborative leader who can motivate cross-functional teams and drive results through influence, not authority.

• You are open to being based in Bangalore, Mumbai or Delhi, and to frequent travel as the role demands

 

We are looking for adaptable, low-ego team players who are passionate about turning AI vision into reality and delivering transformative impact for our customers.

 
 

Hiring Process

 

• Talent Acquisition screening call

• 30min Hiring Manager Interview

• 45min Business Acumen Interview 

• 60min Technical Deep Dive on LLMs

• Panel (Home Prep & Restitution)

• 30min Value Talk

• Reference check

 

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Software Engineer Network Automation, Data Center Fabrics
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As a Software Engineer, Network Automation - Data Center Fabrics, you will help design and build systems for operating large-scale networks within our data centers. You will apply deep networking expertise to leaf-spine architecture, automation, testing, and production troubleshooting across Ethernet switching, IP routing, BGP, EVPN/VXLAN, and VRFs.

This is a hands-on role for a networking expert who is also comfortable building production software. Go and Kubernetes experience are helpful but not required; strong engineering fundamentals and network automation experience matter more.

What You Will Do

  • Design and evolve leaf-spine underlays, EVPN/VXLAN overlays, and tenant connectivity for multi-tenant AI infrastructure.

  • Translate data-center fabric requirements and safety properties into clear APIs, data models, validation, and automation.

  • Build reliable control-plane software that reconciles desired and observed network state.

  • Design safe change workflows with validation, dry runs, atomic updates, observability, and failure recovery.

  • Integrate with data-center switch operating systems and management APIs while maintaining vendor-neutral abstractions where practical.

  • Participate in the on-call rotation, troubleshoot active data-center network incidents, restore service, and turn root causes into lasting improvements.

  • Review designs and code, explain networking trade-offs, and help raise network engineering quality across the organization.

  • Develop lab and production tests and turn operational lessons into better software and architecture.

What We’re Looking For

  • Deep hands-on experience with Ethernet switching, IP routing, BGP-based leaf-spine fabrics, EVPN/VXLAN, and VRF-based multitenancy.

  • Strong judgment around fabric underlay and overlay design, scale, convergence, isolation, and failure modes.

  • Experience building or operating production network automation, including desired state, idempotency, concurrency, observability, and recovery.

  • Strong software-engineering fundamentals in a general-purpose language. You can design, test, debug, and review production systems and are willing to become productive in Go.

  • Experience with southbound network APIs and structured configuration, such as REST, gNMI/OpenConfig, or NETCONF.

  • Hands-on experience with major data-center network operating systems, such as Cumulus Linux, Arista EOS, SONiC, Junos, or NX-OS.

  • Strong diagnostic skills using routing and EVPN state, packet captures, counters, telemetry, and logs.

  • Clear, pragmatic communication and a collaborative approach to technical leadership.

Nice to Have

  • Experience reading, reviewing, or contributing to Go code.

  • Familiarity with Kubernetes controllers, operators, CRDs, reconciliation, or Kubebuilder.

  • Experience with physical or simulated network labs such as containerlab, NVIDIA Air, EVE-NG, GNS3, or similar environments.

  • Experience with high-performance Ethernet, RoCE, InfiniBand, HPC, or large-scale GPU infrastructure.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About the Role

Join Mistral AI's Data Partnerships team and help shape the future of AI data. Working closely with cross functional teams, including IP & Licensing, Engineering, and Research, you will contribute to the processes and initiatives that enable high quality data to support frontier AI development.

As an AI Data Solutions Intern, you will become an expert user of internal tools and workflows that support our data partnerships initiatives related to STEM academic content. For the next 6 months, you will analyze existing processes, identify opportunities to improve efficiency and scalability, and explore how AI can be applied to solve complex operational challenges. Your insights will help inform product improvements and contribute to the evolution of our internal capabilities.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex problems with AI, is excited about emerging technologies, and wants to design smarter ways of working through experimentation, analysis, and thoughtful collaboration.

What You Will Do

  • Analyze data, workflows, and user feedback to identify improvement opportunities.

  • Prototype and evaluate AI-enabled solutions using Python, SQL, spreadsheets, APIs, or LLMs.

  • Conduct research and analysis to support product, partnership, and operational decisions.

  • Support content discovery and evaluate high quality data sources for AI applications.

  • Document findings and present recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Collaborate closely with Engineering, Research, Product, and IP & Licensing teams.

  • Passion for AI and curiosity about applying emerging technologies to solve real-world problems.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As our VP of Global Developer Relations, you’ll be the voice and facilitator of Mistral to the developer, scientific, and technical communities. You’ll build and scale a global DevRel strategy that fosters deep engagement, advocacy, and love for Mistral’s models and technology. Your team will build communities and educate, excite, and empower developers to adopt, innovate, and evangelize Mistral’s technology—whether they’re startups, enterprises, researchers, or open-source contributors.

You’ll work closely with Product, Research, Engineering, Marketing, Communications, and more to ensure developers have the tools, resources, and inspiration they need to succeed with Mistral.

What You Will Do

Build a Global Developer Movement

  • Develop and execute a global DevRel strategy that connects Mistral and our AI platform effectively with developers, scientists, and technologists.

  • Create authentic, developer-first engagement—focusing on education, inspiration, and community, with great content and AI tools.

  • Foster a culture of advocacy where developers naturally champion Mistral in their networks, projects, and conversations.

Engage and Inspire the Technical Community

  • Lead high-impact developer engagement initiatives, including:

    • Technical content (e.g., tutorials, blog posts, videos, documentation) that helps developers get started, optimize, and innovate with Mistral’s models.

    • Community programs (e.g., hackathons, meetups, AMAs, Discord/Slack communities) that bring together AI builders, researchers, and enthusiasts.

    • Evangelism & thought leadership (e.g., conference talks, podcasts, technical deep dives) that showcase Mistral’s unique value and capabilities.

  • Work with Product and Research teams to translate complex AI innovations into accessible, exciting, and actionable insights for developers.

Enable Developer Success, particularly for self-service adoption

  • Build scalable enablement programs (e.g., onboarding guides, SDKs, APIs, sample projects) that reduce friction for developers adopting Mistral’s models.

  • Create feedback loops between the developer community and Mistral’s Product/Engineering teams to shape the roadmap based on real-world needs.

Scale a World-Class DevRel Team

  • Hire, mentor, and lead a global team of Developer Advocates, Engineers and Evangelists - with particular strength in Europe and San Francisco

  • Define metrics and KPIs to measure the impact of DevRel (e.g., developer adoption, community growth, engagement, advocacy).

  • Lead from the front as a fantastic representative of Mistral at events, in social, and in project communities

Drive Open Source & Ecosystem Growth

  • Champion open-source contributions and collaborative innovation around Mistral’s models.

  • Partner with startups, enterprises, and academic institutions to accelerate adoption and co-innovation.

  • Identify and nurture key developer influencers, maintainers, and ambassadors who can amplify Mistral’s reach and impact.

What We're Looking For

  • Proven leadership in Developer Relations, Developer Marketing, or Technical Evangelism for a B2B technology company, preferably in AI, cloud, and open-source.

  • Deep technical credibility—ability to engage with developers, scientists, and engineers on their terms (e.g., code, research, architecture).

  • Passion for community building—a track record of growing and nurturing technical communities (e.g., open-source projects, developer forums, hackathons).

  • Strong storytelling and communication skills—ability to simplify complex concepts and inspire developers through content, talks, and interactions.

  • Strategic and operational excellence—ability to scale DevRel globally while maintaining a hands-on, authentic approach.

  • Collaborative mindset—ability to work across Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Sales to align DevRel with Mistral’s broader goals.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Experience in AI, machine learning, or large language models (LLMs).

  • Personally contributed meaningfully to open source projects and communities.

  • Led global DevRel teams in high-growth, competitive markets.

  • Personal brand or following in the developer or AI community Experience launching and scaling developer-focused products or tools.


What We Offer

jobs.title: Security Compliance Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Role summary

As a Security Compliance Specialist, you will contribute to the development and operation of Mistral AI’s cybersecurity compliance program. You will support the implementation and maintenance of security frameworks, coordinate compliance activities across the organization, and help the company obtain and maintain the certifications required to support its growth and enterprise business.

What you will do

  • Contribute to the development and ongoing management of Mistral AI’s cybersecurity compliance program.

  • Support the definition, implementation, and maintenance of the Information Security Management System.

  • Coordinate cybersecurity compliance activities, including internal reviews, control assessments, and external audits.

  • Collect, review, and organize evidence from relevant stakeholders to demonstrate compliance with certification and regulatory requirements.

  • Help teams understand their responsibilities and expected contributions to compliance initiatives.

  • Develop and deliver cybersecurity compliance training and awareness materials.

  • Participate in cybersecurity risk assessments and support the monitoring of remediation actions.

  • Maintain compliance documentation, policies, procedures, control records, and audit materials.

  • Track changes in relevant cybersecurity standards and regulations and assess their potential impact on the organization.

  • Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Legal, and other teams to identify certifications that may support customer acquisition and business development.

  • Help evaluate and prioritize new certification initiatives based on business value, customer demand, implementation effort, and cost.

About you

  • 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity compliance, information security governance, risk management, or a related field.

  • Experience supporting cybersecurity compliance programs, certification processes, or external audits.

  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity standards and frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, HDS, SecNumCloud, or C5.

  • Familiarity with cybersecurity regulations such as NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act, LPM, or DORA.

  • Knowledge of requirements relating to sensitive or classified information, such as II 901 or IGI 1300, would be an advantage.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage documentation and coordinate multiple stakeholders.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

  • Ability to work collaboratively across technical, legal, commercial, and operational teams.

  • Professional proficiency in English; French proficiency is a plus.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

Value prop validation for customer:

Deal management & closing:

- Develop and execute strategic sales plans to convert leads into valued customers — you are the first point of contact for all external stakeholders and are responsible for properly managing deals and aligning all stakeholders (heavy involvement of customer engineering, product, and commercial teams, both on operational and C-level)

- Handle customer negotiation end2end, together with our legal and implementation specialist team

 

Executive Engagement:

- Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with C-level executives, heads of innovation/AI, and other key decision-makers within target organisations

- Comprehend their specific challenges and needs, positioning our solution as an integral part of their strategic initiatives

 

Technical Aptitude:

- Demonstrate a deep understanding of the technical intricacies of our product and articulate its value proposition effectively to potential clients

- Work side-by-side with our implementation team to ensure that customer’s questions, concerns and challenges are taken care of during pre-sales, deployment and post-deployment phase

- Collaborate with our technical team to address any customer inquiries or concerns

 

Training and enablement:

-Empower internal teams with the knowledge and resources that you collect in customer conversations to drive product roadmap and align on priorities

 

What We're Looking For:

 

- 7-10 years experience in Sales for FSI (enterprise sales/consultative selling, ideally selling a highly complex, technical product)

- Excellent academics: Bachelor and/or Master Degree in Business, Computer Science, or a related field

- Strong technical skills to navigate quickly evolving products and steer technical discussions

- Excellent English & French, additional language welcome (e.g. German, Spanish, etc.)

- Outstanding negotiation and communication skills

- Leverage successful POC outcomes to facilitate the conversion of POCs into long-term, revenue-generating contracts

 

Deal management & closing:

- Develop and execute strategic sales plans to convert leads into valued customers — you are the first point of contact for all external stakeholders and are responsible for properly managing deals and aligning all stakeholders (heavy involvement of customer engineering, product, and commercial teams, both on operational and C-level)

- Handle customer negotiation end2end, together with our legal and implementation specialist team

 

Executive Engagement:

- Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with C-level executives, heads of innovation/AI, and other key decision-makers within target organisations

- Comprehend their specific challenges and needs, positioning our solution as an integral part of their strategic initiatives

 

Technical Aptitude:

- Demonstrate a deep understanding of the technical intricacies of our product and articulate its value proposition effectively to potential clients

- Work side-by-side with our implementation team to ensure that customer’s questions, concerns and challenges are taken care of during pre-sales, deployment and post-deployment phase

- Collaborate with our technical team to address any customer inquiries or concerns

 

Training and enablement:

-Empower internal teams with the knowledge and resources that you collect in customer conversations to drive product roadmap and align on priorities

 

What We're Looking For:

 

- 7-10 years experience in Sales for Manufacturing (enterprise sales/consultative selling, ideally selling a highly complex, technical product)

- Excellent academics: Bachelor and/or Master Degree in Business, Computer Science, or a related field

- Significant work experience within AI ecosystem or related data/infrastructure field

- Experience at successful fast growing startup, ideally in deep-tech

- Strong technical skills to navigate quickly evolving products and steer technical discussions

- Excellent English & French, additional language welcome (e.g. German, Spanish, etc.)

- Outstanding negotiation and communication skills

jobs.title: Communications Lead, Science & Research
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As a Science & Research Communications Lead on the Communications team, you will shape how the world understands Mistral’s scientific breakthroughs. This role exists to build and amplify our Science & Research narrative, positioning our team among the leading AI labs globally. You will drive the strategy for Science Communications, ensuring our discoveries and innovations are accessible, engaging, and influential across the AI community and beyond.

 
 

What You Will Do

  • Define and execute a global Science Communications strategy across earned, owned, and paid media.

  • Build compelling narratives around key milestones, making complex research accessible to AI scientists, developers, journalists, and the broader community.

  • Develop proactive storytelling through blog posts, videos, and podcasts that highlight Mistral’s unique scientific contributions in areas like Physics AI and Robotics.

  • Position Science team members as thought leaders through high-impact speaking opportunities, media placements, and events.

  • Support Mistral’s open-source narrative and highlight our role in the open-source ecosystem.

  • Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders to gather insights and ensure cross-functional alignment.

  • Monitor industry discussions on Science, Research, and AI to identify opportunities for Mistral to lead the conversation.

 
 

What We're Looking For

  • At least 5+ years of experience in Communications, with solid experience in Tech, AI, or Research.

  • Solid understanding of AI, with knowledge of Science and Research.

  • Track record in Communications within Science, Deep Tech, or AI, ideally in fast-paced tech environments.

  • Ability to simplify complex research for diverse audiences, from scientists to the general public.

  • Experience crafting creative, high-impact communications campaigns and working with agencies or freelancers.

  • Strong writing and storytelling skills, with a sharp editorial eye for narratives that resonate.

  • Ability to build trust with technical stakeholders and defend positions with clarity and grit.

  • Familiarity with the AI scientists’ online community and open-source ecosystem.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition, APAC
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Role Summary

As an experienced Talent Acquisition specialist on the APAC recruiting team, you will be instrumental in building and scaling teams at Mistral across the region - Singapore, Korea, India, Australia and Japan. You will get a wide breadth of exposure across roles, geographies, levels.

Joining Mistral in APAC today means you’ll sit at the intersection of recruiting strategy and best practice execution at scale. TAs at Mistral get a seat at the table, deep influence in decision making, and are sparring partners to hiring managers.

Your work will directly influence our success by ensuring we find and engage exceptional people who will drive Mistral’s growth. You will also foster a strong candidate experience to create a flywheel for our employer brand int he region. You will also help establish recruiting best practice by creating, documenting and scaling knowledge and playbooks.

 

What you will do:

 

  • Partner with our tech & business hiring managers to find world-changing talent for Mistral

  • Own end-to-end recruitment, including sourcing, interviewing, and closing candidates

  • Identify unique candidates who bring an entrepreneurial spirit, strong commitment and passion for success 

  • Guide candidates through our hiring process and introducing them to the magic of working at Mistral 

  • Develop and refine recruiting processes, tools, and documentation to improve outcomes and efficiency

  • Use data to diagnose process issues and propose solutions

  • Deliver a high-quality candidate experience in a competitive talent market

  • Collaborate with others to continuously raise the bar for our hiring standards

  • Contribute directly to defining and evolving our talent acquisition approach in APAC

 

About you:

• 8+ years of total recruiting experience, ideally across a mix of executive search, high growth startups, and enterprise/corporate environments

• Demonstrated ability to hire at high throughput at scale, and in complex environments, never compromising quality

• A self-starter who is result-oriented, resourceful, innovative, intellectually curious, and who takes initiative and risks.

• You are T-shaped with deep expertise in either Sales/GTM or Technical roles

• Experience in complex recruiting  and autonomous hiring in outbound contexts 

• Experience working to recruit in highly competitive talent markets 

• Strong written and verbal communication

• No ego and highly committed to deliver. 

• Able and keen to to jump from strategic topics to very hands-on work

• Open learning mindset and fast learner, demonstrated capacity to quickly grasp new complex topics

• Capability, credibility, and consultative skills to influence senior colleagues and stakeholders without authority.

• Organized, disciplined and strong at project management

• Comfortable working within the ambiguity of a small, growing startup with a strong desire to turn that ambiguity into a well-defined machine.

• Target driven, detail oriented and approachable with the ability to prioritize and work well in an environment with competing demands.

• Fluent in english and experience recruiting internationally 

• Ideally, proficiency with Ashby, LinkedIn Recruiter, and AI tools (Vibe, Claude..)

 

Benefits

 

Singapore

 

💰 Competitive cash salary and equity

🚑 Health Insurance

jobs.title: Partner Technical Enablement, EMEA
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

 

Mistral succeeds when partners can confidently position, implement, support, and continuously improve Mistral AI solutions for their customers. As a member of Partner Technical Enablement, you’ll make that repeatable at scale by building reusable enablement assets, delivering training and workshops, and maintaining a tight feedback loop with Product and Engineering

 

What You Will Do

 

  • Produce and maintain high-quality, reusable technical assets: technical demos, reference architectures, and partner-adaptable pilots

  • Develop and deliver training materials and courses for our Partner training platform

  • Drive enablement at scale across all partner channels via training, conference sessions, and certification programs

  • Represent Mistral AI at partner, customer, and industry events, including executive briefings, conferences, and developer gatherings

  • Lead or support partner focused technical workshops, hackathons, and community events that drive adoption of Mistral AI solutions

  • Provide feedback and signals to GTM, Marketing, Product and Engineering teams

 
 

What We're Looking For

 

  • Experience working extensively with systems integrators or technology company ecosystems, including at least one hyperscaler ecosystem (AWS, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Azure)

  • Experience building, launching, and expanding scalable partner enablement programs

  • Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts and advanced implementations

  • Skilled at leading hands-on technical sessions and workshops, including successful hackathons

  • Ability to create compelling technical demonstrations and reference implementations partners can adapt

  • Experience creating high-quality technical content across multiple formats (written, video, and audio/podcasts)

  • Proven success driving partner technical engagement and technical adoption

  • Strong Python or TypeScript skills

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with learning platforms (SCORM/LMS) and content ops: versioning, QA, release notes, analytics.

  • Hands-on experience with enterprise deployments (security, IAM, networking, observability), plus the ability to build and maintain reference code (SDKs, templates, CI/CD).

  • Use of AI tools to draft, test, and document faster without cutting corners on quality

 

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.
